dedupe_keys.name: lidar scans of reinforced concrete building performance following the april 25 2015 nepal earthquake

description: Lidar Scans of Reinforced Concrete Building Performance following the April 25, 2015 Nepal Earthquake is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Andre Barbosa, Oregon State University (oregonstate.edu). The researchers collected data on the performance of buildings following the 2015 Gorkha earthquake in Nepal. The focus of the research team was on the assessment of infilled RC frame buildings, however, data was also collected on unreinforced masonry buildings and temples, to better understand the vulnerability of the building construction of Nepal. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS2P082. Keywords: Nepal, earthquake, lidar, structure from motion. Published 2017-10-06. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
